# Reference STL fixture inventory

`rc-manifest.json` is generated by `tools/Inspect-StlFixtures.py` and records hashes, byte counts, format, triangle counts, source-unit bounds, finite-coordinate checks, and exact-vertex edge multiplicity indicators for the user-supplied `rc/` models. Directory placement supplies the item/container role; simplified filenames do not imply an LOD relationship.

Coordinates and container whole-closed-shape usable interior-volume semantics are user-confirmed in millimeters. The inventory's topology indicators alone do not establish valid solids. Distribution provenance is not recorded by these tests.

`import-expectations.json` pins reviewed T-003 public inspection outcomes, bound to
the inventory hash: all six containers and three items are accepted; the supplied
`pryanik_simplified.stl` is rejected with 13 self-intersection pairs. An independent
exact coplanar-overlap check confirms a real defect. The second Pryanik's inward
shell remains a cavity, with its parent and depth pinned. All nine accepted
volumes match an independent exact signed determinant sum over the original STL
coordinates, rounded once after division by six. Source bytes remain unchanged.

The compact records retain physical results, diagnostic completion, cleanup and
work counts, and full-resolution mesh hashes. Discovery never updates this file.
Use [the import qualification runner](../../benchmarks/README.md) to compare a
Release build with these expectations; record and review any baseline change in
[T-003 evidence](../../doc/T-003.md) or its successor ticket.
